about.FIBONACCI: Ratios of the last swing (38.2%, 61.8%, 161.8%…) where pullbacks often pause or targets sit.
about.LEVELS: Prices the market reacted to before: support/resistance zones, round numbers, pivots, previous highs and lows.
about.TREND: Direction and strength: higher highs and lows, breaks of structure, trendlines, moving averages, ADX.
about.CHART_PATTERN: Shapes formed by several swings (M/W, head and shoulders, triangles, flags) with a breakout line.
about.CANDLESTICK: One- to three-bar patterns, weighted more when they appear at a level.
about.MOMENTUM: Oscillators such as RSI, MACD, Stochastic and CCI: divergences, crosses, extremes.
about.VOLATILITY_VOLUME: Quiet ranges that expand (Bollinger, Keltner, Donchian), range expansion and tick-volume spikes.
about.ICHIMOKU: Price against the cloud, Tenkan/Kijun crosses and Chikou confirmation.
about.SMART_MONEY: Liquidity sweeps, fair value gaps, order blocks, supply/demand zones and Wyckoff springs.
about.HARMONIC: XABCD patterns (Gartley, Bat, Crab…) whose legs follow Fibonacci ratios, ending in a reversal zone.
about.ELLIOTT: Wave counts (impulse 1–5, correction A–C); heuristic, so they carry the least weight.
about.SESSIONS: Breakouts of the Asian range or the opening range of a session.

riskLimits.title: Risk limits in use

source.cloud: Source: your trading profile, received from the cloud.
source.cache: Source: the last trading profile the engine received (the cloud is not reachable now).
source.local: Source: the engine machine's own profile (no trading profile from the cloud yet).

riskLimits.explain: For each value the engine uses the stricter of your profile and the engine machine's config.yaml. The engine machine's values can only be changed on that machine.
riskLimits.pending: Saved. The engine picks up the new values within about a minute.
riskLimits.unavailable: The engine has not reported the limits it uses yet (an older engine version, or no account snapshot).
